Name: Jotbah
Description: The home town of Meshullemeth, mother of Amon king of Judah, named in the account of Amon's brief and wicked reign.
BiblicalSignificance: Jotbah is remembered through one woman: the mother of a king whose reign lasted two years and ended in conspiracy.
RelatedPeople: Amon, King of Judah; Meshullemeth, Mother of Amon
